card.name: Lookback time spans in contraindications
card.fires_on: The time-unit word (usually "months") after a number in a look-back phrase such as "in the last 6 months", mostly in contraindication lists. It also fires on "than" or "by" in similar condition-timing phrases.

modes.label: Months after a number
modes.description: The word "months" or "month" ending a look-back period for a past event.
modes.example: In the last 6<< months>>, experienced myocardial infarction,

modes.label: Duration link words
modes.description: "than" in "for more than N days" or "by" after "confirmed" within a restriction.
modes.example: opioids for more<< than>> 7 consecutive days immediately prior to taking
